pattern: に耐える / に耐えない（にたえる / にたえない）
aliases: にたえる / にたえない
purpose: Judge whether something can bear examination or evoke an intense feeling.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
V dictionary / N + に耐える / に耐えない; emotion noun + に堪えない
This paper can withstand rigorous criticism.
The devastated garden is unbearable to look at.
I cannot express how grateful I am for your support.
formation: V dictionary / N + に耐える / に耐えない; emotion noun + に堪えない
restrictions: 見るに耐えない concerns an unbearable sight; 感謝に堪えない expresses overwhelming thanks.
mistake: Use 耐 for withstanding or enduring; overwhelming emotion conventionally uses 堪, as in 感謝に堪えない.
